Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifiers and canonical SMILES for compounds tested in assays against the target CHEMBL2146302. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then to assays, then to target_dictionary filtering by target ChEMBL ID CHEMBL2146302. Join compound_structures on molregno to retrieve canonical SMILES. Return columns compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
